title: bug-report-quality-rubric template variables
description: Values for templates/bug-report-quality-rubric.md.j2 and templates/bug-report-quality-rubric.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from bug-report-quality-rubric.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

actor_role.title: Actor role
actor_role.description: The role the reproducing user must hold. A large share of "cannot reproduce" is the reporter being an admin and the triager not being one.

build_sha.title: Build sha
build_sha.description: The build number or git SHA you saw this on. "Latest" ages within the hour and turns the report into something nobody can falsify or close.

observable_symptom.title: Observable symptom
observable_symptom.description: What you saw, phrased so a stranger could recognise it without your context - "submit no-ops on an email with a leading space". Not "it is broken", not a theory about why.

priority.description: Business urgency - how soon someone must act. A low-severity bug on the signup page can be P0; a critical one in an unreleased feature can be P3.

severity.description: Technical impact if nothing is done. Data loss or corruption is critical however few users hit it. This is not urgency - urgency is the next field.

start_url.title: Start url
start_url.description: The exact URL the reproduction starts from, query string included. A reproduction that opens with "log in and navigate to" is a reproduction nobody will actually run.

surface.title: Surface
surface.description: The screen, endpoint or component where it shows - "Login form", "POST /v1/orders". It is the first word of the title and the thing triage routes on, so use the team's name for it.
